text:
I'm revising my earlier answer: title is in the friend, the surviving son, the daughter, and any additional children of the sister born during her lifetime, with the friend's fee subject to their executory interests. The gift over to the sister's children is not void under the Rule Against Perpetuities as I said before, and the "born within 21 years after the deceased son's death" version of the class-closing rule gives the same parties. I can't tell from the shared note which closing rule the question intends, so my confidence is moderate.

CONFIDENCE: 55
